The user wants a planning document for a quant engineering task: excavating a maker/passive-execution strategy from existing Kalshi weather market data, linking it to FV (fair value) + flow gates. They want ONLY labeled sections: PLAN, RISKS, CHECKPOINTS, IF_FAIL, DECISION_RULES. No prose outside.

Let me think about the actual quant content carefully.

State:
- 36M book snapshots, 704k trades, 144k flow signals, 94k acted shadow, 80k settled.
- FV cells mostly unarmed (daily NO miscalibration) — fair value model not yet trusted.
- Flow rule gate just wired: micro_dev / aggression_w2m (microprice deviation / weighted 2-min aggression) separate settlement PnL by 5-6c for buy_NO — so flow features have demonstrated separation on settlement outcomes.
- fill_sim.py Stage0 offline only — a fill simulator, offline.
- DESIGN_maker: Stage1 = passive entry on already-licensed trades (i.e., trades the taker engine already wants to take, but instead of crossing spread, post passively and see if filled); Stage2 = two-sided quoting later.
- Engines only bet NO; taker pays 2-6c spread+fee.

Constraints:
- Shrink-only flow (shrinkage / conservative gating, never loosen).
- No live maker until LEARNING→ARMED on pessimistic fills.
- Reuse cell gate (the existing FV cell arming machinery).
- No lowering N_MIN (minimum sample counts stay).
- Offline first.

Already tried: rare-event 1m/5m flow models never arm; settlement join proves feature value (i.e., features work when joined to settlement outcomes, but the rare-event framing never reaches statistical power / arming thresholds).

Objective: find the best way to excavate a maker/passive-execution strategy from existing data and link to FV + flow gates.

So the plan should be:

PLAN:
1. Excavation study — replay passive fills on the 94k acted shadow set. For each licensed taker trade (buy_NO), simulate posting at bid (or one tick inside) instead of crossing. Use book snaps + trades tape to determine fill: (a) conservative rule — fill only if subsequent trade prints at or below our bid (queue-ahead assumption), (b) mark-out analysis at +30s/2m/5m/settlement for filled vs unfilled vs taker baseline. Measure: fill rate, adverse selection (markout conditional on fill), missed-trade cost (unfilled but winner), net EV per trade vs taker baseline paying 2-6c.

2. Pessimistic fill model — define fill_sim Stage0 rules: join-at-bid, queue position conservative (assume back of queue), fill only on trade-through or price move below bid; penalize fills that occur within X ms of adverse flow signal (flow-informed fills are toxic). This is the "pessimistic fills" that gate LEARNING→ARMED.

3. Link to flow gate: stratify passive fills by micro_dev/aggression_w2m buckets at quote time. Hypothesis: when aggression is against us (sellers hitting NO bid... wait, we buy NO; the passive entry is posting a bid on NO). Adverse selection: fills happen when someone sells NO aggressively → those are the toxic fills. Use the 5-6c separation already proven: condition quoting on flow state — quote only when flow is neutral/favorable; suppress when aggression_w2m signals informed selling of NO.

4. Link to FV gate: reuse cell gate. For cells that are LEARNING/ARMED... but FV cells mostly unarmed due to daily NO miscal. So plan: run the excavation per-cell; the maker edge has two components: (a) spread capture (microstructure edge, doesn't need FV), (b) FV edge (needs armed cells). For unarmed cells, passive entry only adds value if spread capture > adverse selection; decision: allow Stage1 passive substitution in unarmed cells only where flow gate passes AND spread ≥ threshold; require armed FV cell for any quote inside... hmm, actually posting at bid in unarmed cells is fine if markouts show non-negative selection.

5. Define metrics & decision thresholds: pessimistic net EV per contract vs taker, fill rate, markout distribution, by cell and flow bucket; bootstrap CIs; N_MIN respected.

6. Shadow Stage1: run fill_sim offline across full 36M snaps for the 94k shadow trades; produce shadow ledger (would-be passive fills, PnL at settlement using 80k settled). Compare: taker actual vs passive pessimistic. If passive net EV ≥ taker + hurdle (say ≥2c after penalties) with CI excluding 0 → propose live shadow (paper) then LEARNING.

Wait — constraint says no live maker until LEARNING→ARMED on pessimistic fills. So the pipeline: offline excavation → offline pessimistic fill sim → shadow LEARNING (live paper quoting? or shadow via existing acted-shadow infra) → ARMED → small live.

Actually "94k acted shadow" already exists — that's the shadow ledger of taker actions. Stage1 reuses it: for each acted shadow trade, compute what a passive fill would have done.

RISKS:
- Adverse selection dominates: passive fills are correlated with informed flow; the 5-6c separation cuts both ways — fills cluster in bad-flow states.
- Fill-sim bias: offline reconstruction of queue position from snaps is optimistic; trade-through rule may overstate/understate fills; snapshot cadence (how frequent are the 36M snaps?) limits resolution — if snaps are 1s+, micro
